key_points: Multiple articles highlight Corning's exposure to AI-driven fiber-optic demand and copper-to-fiber transition.
Seeking Alpha upgrades (twice) and Motley Fool bullish pieces suggest positive analyst sentiment.
SurgoCap Partners sold its entire Corning position in Q3, a notable institutional exit.
Import‑restriction speculation and data‑center permitting headlines add uncertainty.
CEO Wendell Weeks' media appearance reinforces long‑term innovation narrative but lacks near‑term catalysts.
